external_entities.name: Duty engineers
external_entities.description: Engineers who open the dispatch console in their browser.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.

external_entities.name: Scheduling partner
external_entities.description: Another company that publishes tomorrow's planned work.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company, publishes tomorrow's planned work.

processes.name: Dispatch console
processes.description: A single-page JavaScript app opened by duty engineers and calling the dispatch API.
processes.source_excerpt: The console is a single-page JavaScript app
processes.notes: The console and the API are served from different origins. CORS allowed origins and credential behavior were not recorded.

processes.name: Corporate web host
processes.description: The corporate web host serves the dispatch console.
processes.source_excerpt: our corporate web host serves it

processes.name: Dispatch API
processes.description: The API used by the dispatch console and schedule importer, running in the production control plane.
processes.source_excerpt: The dispatch API runs in the production control plane.
processes.notes: The control plane is not reachable from the internet.

processes.name: Schedule importer
processes.description: A process on the corporate network that pulls and parses the scheduling partner's SOAP feed and posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API.
processes.source_excerpt: Our schedule importer runs on the corporate network.
processes.notes: The partner's identification of the importer and the importer's identification of the partner were not recorded. The API token has not been rotated since the importer was built.

data_stores.name: Dispatch database
data_stores.description: Database holding job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and the token or session that created each job order.
data_stores.source_excerpt: That database holds the job orders, the crew names and the crew mobile numbers.

data_stores.name: Schedule archive
data_stores.description: A folder on the corporate file store containing each XML document downloaded from the scheduling partner.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive
data_stores.notes: The schedule archive is a folder on the corporate file store.

data_stores.name: Corporate file store
data_stores.description: The corporate file store containing the schedule archive folder.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a folder on the corporate file store

data_flows.name: Open dispatch console
data_flows.description: Duty engineers open the dispatch console in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They open the dispatch console in their browser.
data_flows.notes: Nobody wrote down how an engineer signs in to it.

data_flows.name: Request dispatch console
data_flows.description: Duty engineers' browsers request the console from the corporate web host.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They open the dispatch console in their browser.

data_flows.name: Serve dispatch console
data_flows.description: The corporate web host serves the single-page JavaScript dispatch console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: our corporate web host serves it

data_flows.name: Call dispatch API
data_flows.description: The dispatch console calls the dispatch API cross-origin.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.notes: The API answers the console cross-origin. Whoever configured CORS did not record which origins the API allows, or whether it allows credentials.

data_flows.name: WebSocket live job status
data_flows.description: The dispatch console opens and holds a WebSocket to the dispatch API for live job status.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console also opens a WebSocket to the dispatch API and holds it open for live job status.
data_flows.notes: Nobody wrote down whether that socket runs over TLS, whether its handshake is authenticated, or whether it checks the engineer's session again after it is open.

data_flows.name: Read and write dispatch database
data_flows.description: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.data_description: job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and the token or session that created each job order

data_flows.name: Pull SOAP feed
data_flows.description: The schedule importer pulls the scheduling partner's planned-work feed every hour.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every hour it pulls the partner's SOAP feed over HTTPS
data_flows.notes: Nothing was written down about how the partner identifies our importer, or how our importer identifies the partner.
data_flows.data_description: tomorrow's planned work in an XML document

data_flows.name: Write schedule documents
data_flows.description: The schedule importer writes each downloaded XML document into the schedule archive.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive
data_flows.data_description: downloaded XML documents containing planned work

data_flows.name: Post parsed work orders
data_flows.description: The schedule importer posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API using an API token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The importer then posts the parsed work orders to the same dispatch API the console calls.
data_flows.notes: The API token was issued when the importer was built and nobody has rotated it since.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where duty engineers, the corporate web host, the dispatch console, the schedule importer, and corporate file storage operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: Production control plane
trust_boundaries.description: The same-company zone holding the live estate, with authority to move a crew and change the work a depot does that day.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The control plane is the same company and the same staff, but it is the zone that holds the live estate

trust_boundaries.name: Scheduling partner
trust_boundaries.description: The zone controlled by the scheduling partner, which is another company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch database's data is confidential.
assumptions.basis: It holds crew names and crew mobile numbers, as well as job orders and the token or session that created each job order; disclosure could harm people or the business.
